_about: SINGLE-TRANSLATION SHELF: more one-off English translations of history, travel, biography and memoir: Gregory of Tours's History of the Franks (Brehaut, 1916), Alberuni's India (Sachau), Columbus's Select Letters (R. H. Major, Hakluyt Society), Barbaro and Contarini's Travels to Tana and Persia (Hakluyt Society), the Mulfuzāt Timūry, Nicolaus of Damascus's Life of Augustus, Naima's Annals of the Turkish Empire, the Baz-nama-yi Nasiri, al-Tūnisī's Travels of an Arab Merchant in Soudan, the Life of Omar ibn Said (written in Arabic by an enslaved man in North Carolina), Jusserand's English Wayfaring Life in the Middle Ages (Lucy Toulmin Smith), Maulde-La-Clavière's Women of the Renaissance, Guizot ×2, Grellmann's Dissertation on the Gipseys (1787), Lederer's Discoveries (1672), Stutterheim's Austerlitz, the Dreyfus letters, Lepsius's Letters from Egypt, the German Arctic expedition, De Amicis's Morocco, Vogüé's The Russian Novelists, lives of Wagner, Baudelaire, Berlioz, Chopin, Sarah Bernhardt, Ludwig II, Carmen Sylva, Gandhi (Rolland), Maria Stella and the Countess of Lichtenau, Russian exile and Siberian memoirs, and records of the First World War. Each title gates on its own translator (_surname_by_slug). US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 45); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_surname_note: Per title: the translator's name forms.
